title: Known Issues Sprint (Feb 2026) — Triage Spreadsheet
content:
Known Issues Sprint — Triage / Publishing Tracker (Customer Success + Support)
Sprint window: 2026-02-03 → 2026-02-14 (follow-up adoption/cleanup week after)
Owner: Priya Shah (Support workflow + KB)
Last pass: 2026-02-15 (post-publish cleanup + missing reviewers)

How to use this sheet
- Goal: pick the smallest set of highest-impact repeat issues where a validated workaround will (a) reduce time-to-mitigation and (b) deflect repeat tickets.
- “Known issue” criteria (see Linear PM-913): reproducible or strongly evidenced, workaround validated by SRE/Eng, customer-safe language, includes “When to escalate” callout, and has an owner for ongoing updates.
- Publication targets:
  - Internal Confluence (Support/CS): can include more operational detail (still avoid customer-identifying info)
  - Public docs/help center: must be sanitized and generally applicable

Legend
- Workaround readiness: Not started | Draft | Needs validation | Validated | Ready to publish
- Publication status: Backlog | Writing | In review | Blocked | Published (internal) | Published (public)
- Impact score (rough): High = P0/P1 repeat + broad tier impact; Med = narrow tier/region; Low = niche or one-off

Quick rollup (as of 2026-02-15)
- Published (public): KI-01, KI-02, KI-05
- Published (internal only): KI-03
- In review: KI-04
- In progress (writing/draft): KI-06, KI-08, KI-10, KI-11
- Backlog / deprioritized: KI-07, KI-09, KI-12

Open questions / blockers
1) KI-06 (pin vs fallback): need definitive, customer-safe statement of behavior per tier + what Support can verify via dashboards. Mina to confirm with routing team; target: 2026-02-18.
2) KI-04 (Private upgrade): confirm rollback steps are safe for both VPC + on-prem packaging. Priya Natarajan + Benji to sign off; target: 2026-02-17.
3) KI-08 (usage spike): who owns billing hooks investigation checklist? (tentative: Platform metering). Chris to route; target: 2026-02-19.
4) SSO + webhook docs: Security review required (Naomi). Ensure we don’t encourage sharing secrets or full config dumps.

Notes from review meeting (condensed)
- Support wants every published known-issue to include a copy/paste “Ask” section: request IDs, region, model, SDK version, timestamps, and whether streaming/retries are used.
- SRE wants “when to escalate” to be threshold-based where possible (error rate, number of customers, sustained duration) and consistent with incident process.
- Docs wants consistent naming: workaround-<short-slug> for known issues; troubleshooting-<slug> for general guidance.

Next update cadence
- During adoption week: daily quick edits as needed; after that: weekly sweep for 4 weeks to keep ‘last updated’ fresh and remove resolved issues from the landing page.
